Title: Management Makeover at a Luxury Brand
Summary: In a strategic effort to overhaul the management framework of a thriving North American luxury manufacturer, Synozur spearheaded a digital transformation initiative in 2023. The project's primary objective was to implement a robust Company Operating System (Company OS) to support the company's rapid growth and scalability. This case study delves into the challenges faced, the solutions introduced by Synozur, and the positive outcomes for leadership effectiveness.
Background: A prominent North American luxury manufacturer engaged Synozur for a digital transformation initiative.
Objective: The company, renowned for its innovative skincare products, experienced significant growth, expanding beyond its existing management framework and the time constraints of its founders. As the company scaled, there was a pressing need to enhance their operating system to support further growth and expansion.
Introduction:
The company's leadership recognized several key challenges:

  • Establishing influence and authority at the executive level and distributing leadership across the growing leadership team (LT).

  • Creating a shared vision and strategy, with clarity on priorities.

  • Implementing a rhythm to maintain focus on business priorities.

Engineers of skincare products needed a scalable management framework that could adapt to their rapid growth. The founders, central figures in the company, acknowledged the necessity of a broader set of tools and processes to sustain and propel their company forward.
Context:
Synozur introduced a comprehensive Company Operating System (CoS) tailored to the client's unique needs. The CoS aimed to:

  • Create and maintain focus on business priorities.

  • Align people, resources, and plans.

  • Provide a clear vision, mission, purpose, and strategy.

The CoS framework included:

  • Annual Plan: Setting yearly objectives and quarterly "rocks" (incremental goals).

  • Weekly Meeting Rhythm: Focus meetings designed to review priorities, analyze metrics, and solve issues collaboratively.
Methodology:
The implementation process encompassed several key phases:


Discovery

Synozur was engaged on a digital transformation project. In discussions with the founders, it became evident that a broader set of tools and processes were needed to support the company's growth and transition from a conversational approach to a more structured and intentional process.


Development

Synozur led workshops with leaders to crystallize the business foundation (mission, value, purpose) and educate the team through ongoing repetitive drip campaigns. Also, Synozur facilitated strategic and annual planning workshops to set clear priorities and objectives.


Deployment

Synozur led weekly focus meetings for several weeks, participating actively before transitioning the leadership team to run these meetings independently. The focus meetings included agenda items for joint problem-solving and scorecard analysis, fostering a collaborative and data-driven approach.

Synozur also prepared company leadership with a custom Company Operating System Manual (COSM). The COSM empowers anyone – not just the founders – to run effective focus meetings.
Results:
Our client as seen significant changes in fiancial impact and leadership team behaviors:

  • Estimated $0.6–$1.3MM annual cost savings and $500K–$1.5M+ in revenue enablement, driven by reduced internal friction and faster execution of commercial and operational initiatives.

  • Introduction of weekly focus meetings, replacing less effective ones.

  • Creation of a company scorecard, providing a shared view of performance metrics and enabling junior leaders to interpret these metrics.

  • Reorganization of the leadership team, establishing new roles such as Chief People Officer, VP of Operations, CFO, and CRO.

The new meeting structure and focus on priorities have led to improved decision-making, operational efficiency, and team dynamics. The leadership team now has a unified "sheet of music" and greater visibility into matters that impact the company's performance.

As a result, the company has an optimized path to executing growth strategies such as plant modernization and new product line launches.
Quote: “Our journey with the Company Operating System has truly transformed the way we operate and lead. The clear focus on priorities and performance metrics have empowered us to make strategic decisions more effectively. We are now aligned and equipped to drive sustainable growth and excellence in our industry.”
Conclusion: The successful implementation of the Company Operating System has been a transformative journey for the North American luxury manufacturer. By aligning leadership practices with strategic priorities and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, the company is well-positioned to achieve sustainable growth and operational excellence. Synozur's tailored approach and commitment to client success have been instrumental in this transformation.

Title: Transforming management frameworks at Microsoft
Summary: When one of Microsoft’s marketing teams sought to reinvent their annual planning “offsite” to establish new goals and a more dynamic and efficient management framework, they turned to Synozur, a leader in strategic consulting. This case study explores how Synozur’s consulting expertise played a pivotal role in revolutionizing Microsoft’s management processes, enhancing team productivity, and fostering innovation.
Background:
Microsoft’s Modern Work organization, part of its’ Cloud Marketing division, is responsible for the marketing and promotion of cutting-edge productivity tools designed to enhance workplace efficiency.  Modern Work Marketing has several Product Marketing Groups (“PMGs”) focused on specific product portfolios across Microsoft 365. Each team typically runs at least one annual multi-day “offsite” planning event to prepare for the upcoming fiscal year.


For one PMG, despite the team’s success in driving product innovation, they lacked a management framework for planning, goal attainment, impact, and team cohesion. Recognizing the need for a more cohesive and agile approach, Microsoft sought Synozur’s expertise to implement a transformative management framework and help with annual planning.
Objective:
The primary objectives of Synozur’s consulting engagement were to:

  • Support the development of team OKRs and an annual plan

  • Develop an integrated team management framework

  • Enhance cross-functional collaboration within the PMG team.

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
Introduction: Synozur embarked on a transformative journey with Microsoft’s Modern Work Product Marketing Group (PMG) to establish a new management framework. The objective was to enhance the team's goal-setting capabilities and improve overall efficiency through data-driven behavioral science and the implementation of Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).
Context:
Product marketing groups at Microsoft are responsible for the business side of their products. They oversee a broad range of products, from well-established mature products, features of larger product suites, and new product launches. They need to engage a broad range of stakeholders – including product engineering, field sales, channel partners, and customers across multiple channels to drive revenue and business success.


Annual planning for marketing (and managing a two-day "offsite" retreat) often poses challenges for any team, given the varied levels of experience with goal setting, and the desire to avoid “BOPSAT” (Bunch Of People Sit Around Talking”).


The PMG leader needed to create a new team culture and establish connected goals and OKRs to ensure success or Microsoft. Offsites happen every year at Microsoft, and with recent expansion of the team, it was essential to deliver high-impact planning.

Synozur's task was to unify the team's approach to defining and achieving goals, thereby fostering a more cohesive and productive working environment.
Methodology:
Synozur adopted a comprehensive and collaborative approach to achieve these objectives. The methodology included:


1. Assessment & Analysis

Synozur began with an in-depth assessment of the PMG team’s existing management framework. This involved:

  • Conducting pre-interviews with key stakeholders to understand pain points and aspirations.

  • Analyzing current workflows, communication patterns, and decision-making processes.

  • Identifying gaps and areas for improvement.


2. Strategic Framework Development

Based on the assessment, Synozur and Microsoft developed the agenda for the offsite meeting, and a plan for establishing a new OKR framework, tailored to the unique needs of the PMG. Key components included:

  • Establishing clear roles and responsibilities to eliminate ambiguity.

  • Implementing agile methodologies to enhance flexibility and responsiveness.

  • Adjusting weekly and monthly team meetings and feedback loops to improve communication and collaboration.

  • Setting OKRs to measure progress and drive accountability.

3. Implementation and Training Offsite

The off-site began with Synozur delivering a comprehensive workshop leveraging the data-driven behavioral methodology. This approach helped the team uncover their working styles and identify ways to collaborate more effectively.


Next, Synozur introduced the team to the concept of OKRs through focused training sessions. Many team members had never previously established or owned personal measurable goals. The training covered the fundamentals of OKRs, how to define them, and how to create new OKRs for the upcoming year.


Microsoft already had established top line goals for revenue, customer engagement, field readiness, channel partner development, and team development. Using design-led thinking, Synozur facilitated exercises to capture, prioritize, and establish a hierarchy of OKRs with measurable results. Although it may seem well know, it was helpful to review the SMART acronym for key results:

  • Specific

  • Measurable

  • Achievable

  • Relevant

  • Time-Bound

Finally, Synozur helped the team develop its initial list of quarterly projects and deliverable to support the new OKRs. This was reduced to a single slide view of major activities for ease of information with other stakeholders.


4. Operationalize

Agreeing on goals is one thing, however operationalizing them is another. Synozur provided individual and group coaching on creating OKRs using Viva Goals, Microsoft’s product for managing organizations OKRs. This included one-on-one time with team members who needed additional support. New rhythms for weekly check-ins and monthly goal reviews were established to create more efficient meetings and ensure that the PMG's goals were met or exceeded.

Synozur worked closely with the PMG to ensure a smooth transition to the new management framework. This stage involved:

  • Conducting workshops and training sessions to familiarize the team with new processes and tools.

  • Providing ongoing support and guidance to address any challenges during the implementation phase.

  • Encouraging a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

  • 1:1 team member coaching as needed

  • Support during weekly and monthly team meetings for several months
Results:
The implementation of Synozur’s Company OS yielded significant benefits for the PMG team:

  • Estimated $0.5M–$1.0M annual productivity cost avoidance, with additional multi‑million‑dollar revenue influence, resulting from improved planning cadence, cross‑team alignment, and faster marketing execution.

  • Higher achievement: By promoting and reviewing OKRs as part of the PMG’s management framework, the team was able to identify issues sooner and ensure that OKR goals were met or exceeded, including >100% revenue growth.

  • Enhanced Collaboration: The new framework facilitated better cross-functional collaboration, breaking down silos and fostering a winning team identity.

  • Improved Efficiency: Agile methodologies and streamlined processes resulted in faster decision-making and accelerated product marketing initiatives.

  • Increased Innovation: Regular feedback loops and a focus on continuous improvement encouraged team members to propose new ideas and experiment with innovative strategies.

  • Clear Accountability: Defined roles, responsibilities, and KPIs ensured that team members were accountable for their contributions, leading to higher performance and productivity.

Synozur's consulting not only enhanced Microsoft's goal-setting and operational capabilities but also fostered a more cohesive and collaborative working environment. Team members better understood their own natural behaviors and that of their teammates, resulting in improved alignment of strengths and team efforts.


The team learned how individual contributions aligned with larger PMG and divisional goals, empowering them to learn from one another's successes. A new monthly communications framework was established to efficiently develop and communicate progress updates to a broad set of leadership stakeholders.
Quote: “I couldn’t be happier with the results. We had a great offsite that brought the team together on common goals instead of running as a band of disconnected individuals. We were able to achieve more on our objectives and share them like never before.”
Quote Attribution: Microsoft senior director of product marketing, M365
Conclusion: Synozur’s consulting expertise played a crucial role in transforming the management framework of Microsoft’s Modern Work Product Marketing Group. By developing and implementing a strategic framework that emphasized collaboration, agility, and continuous improvement, Synozur enabled the PMG to achieve new levels of efficiency and innovation.
